_note: The parts of speech to look up (/grammar/parts-of-speech) and Regi's line under the part-of-speech label of the flashcards (wortschatz-app.js). `practice` = the anchor of the exercise on /parts-of-speech where the class comes up. `fehler` = the word pair on /grammar/common-mistakes that belongs to the class; empty until `idioms-mistakes` has Spanish pairs (the old ones were English). `id` = the pos field in the lexicon; the article has no lexicon word of its own but belongs here. `examples` are set by hand (Spanish, A1) so the page does not depend on the lexicon. `say` is the short form for the card (≤ 8 words), `what` the sentence on the page, `tr` its translation into the help languages (`en` = the same sentence; ar/uk/tr: machine-assisted draft, reviewed:false, removed where `what` changed for Spanish).

classes.name: Noun
classes.say: A noun is a name for something.
classes.what: A noun is a name: for a person, an animal, a thing or an idea.
classes.tip: Every Spanish noun is masculine or feminine: el libro, la casa. Most nouns have a plural: libro – libros. Names of people and places start with a capital letter: Amina, Sevilla.

learn.label: Nouns and gender: rule and exercises

tr.en: A noun is a name: for a person, an animal, a thing or an idea.
tr.ar: الاسم هو اسم: لشخص أو حيوان أو شيء أو فكرة.
tr.uk: Іменник — це назва: людини, тварини, речі чи ідеї.
tr.tr: İsim bir addır: bir kişinin, hayvanın, eşyanın ya da düşüncenin adı.

classes.name: Article
classes.say: An article comes before a noun.
classes.what: An article comes before a noun and agrees with it: el, la, los, las for a thing we both know; un, una, unos, unas for one of many, or some.
classes.ask: el or la? un or una?
classes.tip: The article shows the gender and the number: el coche, la casa, los coches, las casas. a + el becomes al and de + el becomes del: voy al banco, vengo del banco.

learn.label: Articles: el, la, un, una – rule and exercises

tr.en: An article comes before a noun and agrees with it: el, la, los, las for a thing we both know; un, una, unos, unas for one of many, or some.

classes.name: Verb
classes.say: A verb says what someone does.

sub.name: pronominal verb
sub.what: A verb that comes with a pronoun: me levanto, te acuerdas, se va.

classes.what: A verb says what someone does or what happens.
classes.ask: What does he do? What happens?
classes.tip: The ending shows the person, so the pronoun is often left out: hablo, hablas, habla. The infinitive ends in -ar, -er or -ir: hablar, comer, vivir.

tr.en: A verb says what someone does or what happens.
tr.ar: الفعل يقول ماذا يفعل شخص ما أو ماذا يحدث.
tr.uk: Дієслово каже, що хтось робить або що відбувається.
tr.tr: Fiil, birinin ne yaptığını ya da ne olduğunu söyler.

classes.name: Adjective
classes.say: An adjective says what something is like.
classes.what: An adjective says what someone or something is like.
classes.tip: An adjective agrees with its noun and usually goes after it: una casa blanca, unos coches blancos. Some have one form for both genders: un piso grande, una casa grande.

tr.en: An adjective says what someone or something is like.
tr.ar: الصفة تقول كيف يكون شخص ما أو شيء ما.
tr.uk: Прикметник каже, яким є хтось або щось.
tr.tr: Sıfat, birinin ya da bir şeyin nasıl olduğunu söyler.

classes.name: Adverb
classes.say: An adverb says when, where or how.
classes.what: An adverb says when, where or how something happens.
classes.tip: Adverbs don't change their form. Many end in -mente: rápidamente, normalmente. Others don't: hoy, aquí, siempre, bien.

tr.en: An adverb says when, where or how something happens.
tr.ar: الظرف يقول متى أو أين أو كيف يحدث شيء ما.
tr.uk: Прислівник каже, коли, де або як щось відбувається.
tr.tr: Zarf, bir şeyin ne zaman, nerede ya da nasıl olduğunu söyler.

classes.name: Pronoun
classes.say: A pronoun stands for a noun.
classes.what: A pronoun stands for a noun, so you don't have to repeat it.
classes.tip: Ana llega tarde. → Ella llega tarde, or just: Llega tarde. Veo a Ana. → La veo.

tr.en: A pronoun stands for a noun, so you don't have to repeat it.
tr.ar: الضمير يحلّ محلّ الاسم — فلا تحتاج إلى تكراره.
tr.uk: Займенник стоїть замість іменника — тож його не треба повторювати.
tr.tr: Zamir bir ismin yerine geçer — böylece onu tekrarlamak zorunda kalmazsın.

classes.name: Preposition
classes.say: A preposition comes before a noun: a, en, de.
classes.what: A preposition comes before a noun and shows place, time or direction.
classes.tip: After a preposition, use a noun, a pronoun or an infinitive: con mi amigo, para ti, antes de salir.

tr.en: A preposition comes before a noun and shows place, time or direction.
tr.ar: حرف الجر يأتي قبل الاسم ويُظهر المكان أو الزمان أو الاتجاه.
tr.uk: Прийменник стоїть перед іменником і показує місце, час або напрямок.
tr.tr: Edat bir ismin önünde durur ve yer, zaman ya da yön gösterir.

classes.name: Conjunction
classes.say: A conjunction joins words and sentences.
classes.what: A conjunction joins words or sentences.
classes.tip: y, o and pero join two sentences: Estoy cansado, pero voy. porque gives a reason. y becomes e before i-: padre e hijo. o becomes u before o-: siete u ocho.

tr.en: A conjunction joins words or sentences.
tr.ar: أداة الربط تربط الكلمات أو الجمل.
tr.tr: Bağlaç kelimeleri ya da cümleleri birbirine bağlar.

classes.name: Number
classes.what: A number word says how much or how many, or in which position.
classes.ask: How many? How much? Which one in order?
classes.tip: dos niños (how many?), el segundo día (which one in order?). uno becomes un before a masculine noun: un libro, veintiún años.

tr.en: A number word says how much or how many, or in which position.
tr.ar: اسم العدد يقول كم — أو في أي ترتيب.
tr.uk: Числівник каже, скільки — або на якому місці.
tr.tr: Sayı sözcüğü ne kadar ya da kaç tane olduğunu söyler — ya da kaçıncı sırada.

classes.name: Phrase
classes.also: not a part of speech, a fixed group of words
classes.say: A phrase: several words, one meaning.
classes.what: A phrase is several words that together have one fixed meaning.
classes.tip: Learn it as a whole. Translated word for word, it often doesn't work: ¿Qué tal?

tr.en: A phrase is several words that together have one fixed meaning.
tr.ar: العبارة الثابتة هي عدة كلمات لها معًا معنى ثابت واحد.
tr.uk: Стійкий вислів — це кілька слів, які разом мають одне стале значення.
tr.tr: Kalıp ifade, birlikte tek bir sabit anlam taşıyan birkaç kelimedir.
